_name: A — pre-hardening (renamed from A_baseline: 'baseline' implied a safe default, which this is not — it reproduces a documented failure mode)  + sliced (tiled) inference
_mechanisms_active: Method 1 face matching (always runs, in every config — never gated by any flag here)
Method 2 dress-colour fallback — UNCONSTRAINED: runs even when a face is visible and matches nobody
Method 3 body re-ID fallback — UNCONSTRAINED: same as above
Face-based registration gate — a new SDT code still requires a visible face in every config, see _registration_note
_mechanisms_disabled: face_says_stranger gate — a visible-but-unmatched face no longer blocks colour/re-ID from attempting a match
face_veto — colour/re-ID matches are accepted even when the visible face clearly contradicts the candidate's stored face
ByteTrack ID-switch guard — a track's cached code is trusted unconditionally, even across an occlusion hand-off to a different person
evidence gating — every sighting with a non-'Detecting...' code is logged, including one inherited from a stale/wrong cache
_registration_note: enable_face_anchor never gates whether a NEW SDT code can be minted. Method 5 (registration) always requires query_face_emb is not None, in ALL FOUR configs — this is a separate, flag-independent gate. What enable_face_anchor actually controls is exclusively re-association of EXISTING people: whether colour/re-ID may run at all when a face is visible-but-unmatched, and whether a contradicting face can veto a colour/re-ID match. With it off, colour/re-ID become unconstrained by face signal for that purpose only.
_expected_risk: This is architecturally what SmartDetect looked like before the 2026-07-30 identity-accuracy hardening. Under an earlier, even-looser version of this architecture (0.30 face-veto threshold, no face_says_stranger gate at all), 3 different people were observed merging into 1 SDT code on a real evaluation clip. This config is the closest reproduction available via flags alone and is expected to merge identities under any clothing-similarity or occlusion stress — that is the point of including it in the ablation.
_tiling_note: DETECTION ONLY — identity flags identical to the untiled variant. min_source_resolution lowered to 640 for the 800x600 ChokePoint frames.
